title: Colosseum with 100 Agents
intro: BOOT runtime started · Colosseum with 100 Agents · readable log grouped by 20-worker batches and discovered skill learning

entries.action: The user requested a build. We have a PNG and need a usable blueprint.

sublines.tools: Send message to Designer: Convert the relevant PNG into a blueprint.

entries.action: Got it. I'll turn the image into a blueprint. First, I'll generate a 3D model.

sublines.tools: Tool call TRELLIS.2: Reconstruct the image into a coarse 3D structure.

entries.action: The 3D model is ready. Next, I'll export it as a Minecraft-compatible OBJ file.

sublines.tools: Tool call ObjToSchematic: Convert the 3D structure into a Minecraft object file.

entries.action: The OBJ file is ready. Now I'll convert it into a buildable JSON blueprint.

sublines.tools: Tool call SchematicToBlueprint: Convert the Minecraft object into a JSON blueprint.

entries.action: Great. We now have the JSON blueprint. I'll notify the Foreman to recruit workers and start the build.

sublines.tools: Tool call Read Blueprint: Read the blueprint and prepare it for splitting.

entries.action: I'll split the blueprint into subtasks[Region A-E] and assign each subtask to the foreman.

sublines.tools: Tool call Split Blueprint: Divide the blueprint into five regions.

sublines.notes: Split Regions: A, B, C, D, E.

sublines.tools: Tool call Validate Split: Check whether the five regions can be built separately.

sublines.results: Verified that the five regions can be built separately.

entries.action: The blueprint has been split and verified. I should assign each region to a foreman and start the build queues.

sublines.tools: Send message to Foreman-[A-E]: Build Region [A-E]

entries.action: Foreman-A..E initialize the build stage: split Regions A-E into one subplan per worker and open five queues in parallel.

sublines.tools: Tool call Split Regions: convert Regions A-E into worker subplans.
Tool call Assign Subplans: prepare one subplan for each worker.

entries.action: Foreman-A assigns A-01 through A-20 to Worker-001..020.

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: A-01 through A-20.

entries.action: Worker-001..020 inspect their assigned placement subplans. No learned skill matches this sequence yet, so they complete the batch with basic tools and leave the Region Placement trace.

sublines.tools: Tool trace: Read Subplan -> Check Inventory -> Go To Region -> Place Blocks.

sublines.results: Result: Region Placement trace collected 20/20.

entries.action: Foreman-A summarizes the completed placement trace and sends it to ProjectManager.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: package Region Placement trace.

entries.action: ProjectManager reviews the repeated worker trace and creates Region Placement.

sublines.tools: Tool call Create Skill: Region Placement.

sublines.results: Result: -> SKILL Region Placement is ready.

entries.action: ProjectManager sends Region Placement back to Foreman-A for distribution.

sublines.tools: Tool call Publish Skill: Send Region Placement to Foreman-A.

entries.action: Foreman-A broadcasts Region Placement to workers handling similar placement subplans.

sublines.tools: Tool call Broadcast Skill: Region Placement to the worker pool.

entries.action: Foreman-A assigns one subplan to each worker in Worker-001..020. Workers will inspect their own subplans and decide whether a learned skill matches.
highlights: decide whether a learned skill matches

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: A-04 through A-20 plus B-01 through B-03.

entries.action: Worker-001..014 inspect their assigned subplans, find the placement pattern matches Region Placement, and use the skill for those work items.

sublines.skills: Use Skill: Region Placement on matched placement work items.

sublines.results: Result: 14 assigned work items are placed with Region Placement.

entries.action: Worker-015..020 inspect their assigned subplans and find the target positions require temporary support. Region Placement alone is not enough, so they run the support sequence with basic tools and leave Scaffold Construction trace examples.

sublines.tools: Tool trace: Read Subplan -> Check Height -> Place Temporary Support -> Reach Target -> Place Blocks -> Remove Temporary Support.

sublines.results: Result: 6 assigned work items are completed with tools; Scaffold Construction trace examples are recorded.

entries.action: Foreman-C assigns one subplan to each worker in Worker-021..040. Workers inspect their own work items and then choose a learned skill or basic tools.
highlights: choose a learned skill or basic tools

sublines.tools: Tool call Assign Subplans: C-01 through C-20 for high-reach region placement.

entries.action: Worker-021..026 complete the reachable part of the high-reach assignment with Region Placement. These tasks are skill reuse, not scaffold trace collection.

sublines.skills: Use Skill: Region Placement on reachable target volumes C-01..C-06.

sublines.results: Result: reachable target volumes are placed.

entries.action: Worker-027..033 reach elevated targets with the same temporary-support tool sequence, adding matching Scaffold Construction trace examples.

sublines.tools: Tool trace: Read Subplan -> Check Height -> Place Temporary Support -> Reach Target -> Place Blocks -> Remove Temporary Support.

sublines.results: Result: repeated support traces are grouped for Foreman-C.

entries.action: Worker-034..040 repeat the temporary-support sequence on the remaining elevated targets, giving ProjectManager enough scaffold examples to create the workflow.

sublines.tools: Tool trace: Read Subplan -> Check Height -> Place Temporary Support -> Reach Target -> Place Blocks -> Remove Temporary Support.

sublines.results: Result: high-reach placement is complete and Scaffold Construction trace collection is ready for learning.

sublines.tools: Send message to ProjectManager: package Scaffold Construction trace.

entries.action: Worker-075..080 remove leftover temporary supports with basic tools; the repeated cleanup sequence becomes Region Cleaning trace evidence.

sublines.results: Result: all five build regions report complete and cleanup trace examples continue into verification.

entries.action: All build regions are complete. Verification now checks the remaining cleanup work.
Started final verification against the blueprint. The checker is looking for leftover temporary supports and cleanup artifacts.

sublines.tools: Tool call Verify Build: compare current blocks against blueprint and cleanup rules.
